title: Add optional git identity pre-push hook
summary: Add an installer for a local pre-push hook that runs the git identity validator before autonomous workers can push, without overwriting user-managed hooks by default.
expectedFailureModes: The identity validator exists but autonomous workers forget to run it before pushing.
The installer overwrites an existing user-managed hook.
The installed hook only works from one working directory instead of resolving the repository root.
The hook blocks pushes with an opaque failure message.
nextAction: Integrated locally; the pre-push hook is installed in this checkout and should remain active through core.hooksPath=hooks.
